# Notes

For those that want to analyse all files:

- Option 1: For-loops
    - Follow these instructions: https://scienceparkstudygroup.github.io/ibed-bioinformatics-page/source/core_tools/bash-for-loops.html
    - Run seqkit, chopper and minimap2 on all files
    - The python script runs on a folder with paf files, so can be run as is
- Option 2: https://github.com/ndombrowski/MicEco_teaching_material/blob/main/source/miceco_analysis.qmd
    - Go to line 193 and rerun seqkit, chopper and minimap2 on all samples (beware that you use the right input files)
